title: Fund2Persona: A Framework for Building and Refining Financial Advisor Personas from Fund Disclosure Data
abstract: arXiv:2606.29793v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Demand for personalized financial advice is growing, yet current LLM-based advisors often fail to provide consistent and specialized guidance.\ Simple persona prompts rarely specify how a financial advisor should reason and often drift toward generic recommendations. We propose Fund2Persona, a framework that builds financial-advisor personas from real-world fund disclosures and refines them through an actor--scorer--patcher loop. We test whether the resulting personas can predict held-out portfolio changes and produce commentary consistent with fund managers' own explanations. They outperform generic baselines on both tasks. We further study two downstream diagnostics: market-scenario generation, where persona retrieval broadens plausible investment views, and multi-turn investor--advisor conversations, where matched personas give more specific and useful advice than a generic advisor. translated_title: Fund2Persona：一个从基金披露数据构建并优化金融顾问人格的框架
translated_abstract: 个性化理财建议的需求日益增长，然而当前基于大语言模型（LLM）的理财顾问往往无法提供一致且专业化的指导。简单的人格提示词很少明确说明金融顾问应如何进行推理，且常常退化为泛泛的建议。我们提出了Fund2Persona，这是一个从真实基金披露文件中构建金融顾问人格、并通过“执行者—评分者—修补者”循环对其进行精炼的框架。我们测试了所构建的人格能否预测留出的持仓组合变化，并生成与基金经理自身解释相一致的市场评论。在这两项任务上，它们均优于通用基线。我们进一步研究了两个下游诊断任务：在市场情景生成任务中，人格检索拓宽了合理投资观点的范围；在多轮投资者—顾问对话中，匹配的人格比通用顾问能给出更具体、更有用的建议。这些结果表明，真实基金数据能够……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Fund2Persona框架利用真实基金披露数据构建并通过“执行者—评分者—修补者”循环优化金融顾问人格，在预测组合变化和生成一致性评论上优于通用基线，并在市场情景生成和多轮投资者对话中提供更具体有用的理财建议。
en_tdlr: Fund2Persona builds and refines financial advisor personas from real fund disclosure data via an actor-scorer-patcher loop, outperforming generic baselines in predicting held-out portfolio changes and generating consistent commentary, while offering more specific and useful advice in market-scenario generation and multi-turn investor-advisor conversations.
